purpose: Evidenced incumbent-process-epoch boundaries for the omen-arc rung. Read by ff_provenance.py. Hand-curated and committed BECAUSE the tool must be deterministic and reproducible: the OS event log is a live source that would make the generated index depend on when it ran. Each entry cites the channel it came from so the claim can be re-checked.
why_epochs_matter: ADR-0042: Vulkan enumeration order on this box is nondeterministic PER PROCESS LAUNCH. A topology observation is therefore evidence about ONE process epoch and does not survive a restart. ArcServeBoot is boot-triggered, so every OS boot starts a new epoch with an independently redrawn device order.
blind_spot: ArcServeBoot carries RestartCount 3 @ PT1M (the ADR-0032 hardening pattern). A crash-restart inside an epoch leaves NO record in any channel listed here -- not the OS boot log, not git, not the receipts. Unrecorded sub-epochs are possible and their absence is not evidence. Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational is enabled=False on this box and holds zero records, so the channel that would have caught them does not exist.

boundaries.evidence: System event log IDs 6005/6009 at 2026-08-26 23:18:19, preceded by 1074 (shutdown initiated) at 23:16:41. ArcServeBoot is boot-triggered, so production restarted here.

Win32_OperatingSystem.LastBootUpTime = 2026-08-28T08:32:52.5-07:00, corroborated by System event log 12 at 08:32:53 and 6005/6009 at 08:33:02, preceded by 1074 at 08:31:46. This is the boot referenced by finding A13 (lanes.json calibrated 08-25, booted 08-28).

FF receipt FF0-placement at 04:39:55 'FIXED - both B70s in service' records removing the visibility filter and restarting. Bracketed by evidence on both sides: the -lv 5 load report at 04:31:42 still showed SINGLE-card, and the FF-CENSUS row at 04:45:59 shows 14.882/15.803 GB across both BDFs. NOTE the commit (8933e82, 04:47:38) came AFTER the restart -- commit time is a lagging indicator here and would have placed this boundary ~8 min late, misfiling the two post-fix census anchors.

git commit d4a8ed3 'RETRACT -ub 1024' touched fleet/arcserve/serve-arc.cmd; the revert only takes effect on restart. Commit time BOUNDS this boundary from above only -- per the 8933e82 precedent the restart likely preceded the commit, so the true boundary is at or before 06:30:16.

Derived from hearth/var/arc-serve.log: the last line carries elapsed 335.30.333 (MM.SS.mmm = 5h35m30s) against file mtime 2026-08-29T13:38:54-07:00, placing process start at ~08:03:24. Corroborated by the FF-POISONING receipt at 08:05:09 recording 'Restart restored 104.86'. This epoch was still open when the index was generated.

not_available.task_scheduler_operational_log: enabled=False, zero records -- cannot contribute epoch boundaries
not_available.per_epoch_load_reports: serve-arc.cmd redirects with '>' (truncate), so only the CURRENT epoch's log survives; and at the default verbosity=3 llama-server emits no 'using device' or 'model buffer size' lines at all. Those lines were only ever obtained by running at -lv 5.
not_available.process_start_time: llama-server runs under an S4U scheduled task; Get-Process StartTime is inaccessible and its CPU counters read 0 while it works.

load_report_anchors.label: confirmed-single
load_report_anchors.evidence: FF receipt FF0-placement at 04:31:42, 'ROOT CAUSE - production defect': device_info listed 'Vulkan0 : Intel(R) Arc(TM) Pro B70 Graphics (32558 MiB)' and 'Vulkan1 : Intel(R) Graphics', llama_prepare_model_devices used Vulkan0 ONLY, and all 49/49 layers landed there = 30108 MiB on one card. This is the FIRST-RANK placement authority per ff_census's own hierarchy -- above b70tools residency, which is activity-windowed. Corroborated by b70tools per BDF: 0000:04:00.0 29.57 GB / 0000:09:00.0 0.00 GB.
